### TQI — hosts e aplicações

Este painel consolida os três hosts de produção: **tqi-platform**, **tqi-platform-edge** e **easy-vm**. A infraestrutura e os logs já são coletados. Os painéis RED e traces passam a exibir dados por host assim que cada processo da aplicação publicar OpenTelemetry no coletor local (`127.0.0.1:4318` para processos no host ou `host.docker.internal:4318` para contêineres).

targets.expr: count(sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$host/.*"}[5m])) or sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]) * on (job, instance) group_left (host_name) max by (job, instance, host_name) (target_info{host_name=~"$host",telemetry_sdk_name="beyla"})))

panels.title: APM RED — requisições por segundo
panels.description: Métricas OpenTelemetry nativas e eBPF por host e serviço.

targets.expr: sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$host/.*"}[5m])) or sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]) * on (job, instance) group_left (host_name) max by (job, instance, host_name) (target_info{host_name=~"$host",telemetry_sdk_name="beyla"}))

panels.title: APM RED — latência p95
panels.description: Métricas OpenTelemetry nativas e eBPF por host e serviço.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$host/.*"}[5m]) or (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) * on (job, instance) group_left (host_name) max by (job, instance, host_name) (target_info{host_name=~"$host",telemetry_sdk_name="beyla"}))))

panels.title: APM RED — taxa de erros 5xx
panels.description: Métricas OpenTelemetry nativas e eBPF por host e serviço.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$host/.*",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) or sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m]) * on (job, instance) group_left (host_name) max by (job, instance, host_name) (target_info{host_name=~"$host",telemetry_sdk_name="beyla"}))) / clamp_min((sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$host/.*"}[5m])) or sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]) * on (job, instance) group_left (host_name) max by (job, instance, host_name) (target_info{host_name=~"$host",telemetry_sdk_name="beyla"}))), 0.000001)
